paragraphs.text: Izzy Wasserstein is a queer and trans woman who was born and raised in Kansas and currently lives in California. She teaches writing and literature at a public university, writes poetry and fiction, and shares a house with a variety of animal companions and the writer Nora E. Derrington. A Lambda Literary Award finalist, she’s the author of two poetry collections, the short story collection All the Hometowns You Can’t Stay Away From (Neon Hemlock, 2022), the novella These Fragile Graces, This Fugitive Heart (Tachyon, 2024), and the fiction chapbook This Next Song is Called Punk Rock Valhalla (Neon Hemlock, 2025).

Wasserstein debuted as a Magic author in July 2026, when her story Spirits of the Abzan was published in connection to Secret Lair Drop Series: Their Magic Is Limitless . This release was a charity collaboration with Global Fund for Women , one of the world's leading foundations for gender justice. It aimed to celebrate women through the women of Magic : the characters on the cards, the artists who brought them to life, and the Wizards creative team behind it all.
